The plate is about 400 px across in the image. If it is a roughly 26 cm dinner plate, that gives about 0.065 cm per px, or roughly 15 px per cm.

The food piece is about 90 px wide and 80 px tall, so it measures roughly 6 cm by 5 cm. Its height is probably 2-3 cm. That gives a volume of about 50 cm³. The texture looks crumbly, like cake, cornbread, or a baked item, so the density is probably low, about 0.5 g/cm³. That puts the mass at around 30 g.

Baked goods like this run about 350 kcal per 100 g, so 30 g comes to roughly 105 kcal. I'll allow a bit more mass for uncertainty and use about 35 g and 120 kcal.

{"kcal": 120, "mass_g": 35}
